scope: synthetic frame-causal mono WPE comparison at a task-local protocol-shaped waveform adapter boundary; no selection, superiority, real-room, device, listening or release claim

public_boundary.registration: none; this task adds no C provider, descriptor, registry entry, installed default or public catalog entry
public_boundary.note: The frame-causal reference consumes one 160-sample input frame at a time and emits one frame at a time with a 480-sample causal content delay. It is task-local Python evidence at a protocol-shaped waveform boundary, not an installed realtime v0 provider.

invariants: Fixed v0 grid only: 16 kHz, mono f32, 160-sample calls; the installed ABI, descriptors, registry, defaults and v0 behavior are unchanged.
The reference is frame-causal: the current frame and strictly earlier frames only; a divergent future frame cannot change already emitted output.
No C provider, CMake subtree, descriptor setting, registry entry or installed default is added by this task.

Identity/noisy controls, paired synthetic SI-SDR/STOI, three RIR stratifications, early-reflection target, movement and overlap controls, clean-source preservation and a no-reference blocked case are all present; no missing result qualifies the candidate.
Rejections for nonfinite, wrong shape, out-of-range, stale session/epoch/position and bad config fail closed without mutating DSP state.
Exact pinned comparisons use three byte-identical cold-start repeats; no tolerance widening or provider substitution is used.
Pinned offline whole-clip WPE results are read only as an explicitly noncausal upper-bound control and are never this task's oracle, threshold or candidate result.
All scores are synthetic scoped; no real speech, model weights, downloads, licensed runtime, listening, MOS/STOI on real speech, target-device pacing or release qualification is claimed.
source_evidence_statements: candidate_matrix.csv row 65: WPE offline/online/multichannel is an evaluated dereverberation candidate with synthetic EARS/SMARD screens and mixed target/RTF outcomes, not an installed SDK provider.
adapters/wpe/README.md: 512-point FFT, 128-hop, 5 taps, 8-frame delay; roughly 80 ms algorithmic latency; the documented offline use is not real time.

REALTIME_COMPONENT_CANDIDATES.md line 59: stateful frame-causal online single-channel WPE has median RTF 0.260 on measured SMARD RIRs, estimated 80 ms algorithmic delay and negligible gains over identity, with mixed synthetic STOI/SI-SDR tradeoffs. These are source findings, not results reproduced here.
research/dereverberation_candidates_20261028.md: WPE outcomes depended on room and matched scoring; the synthetic conditions here are a comparison, not a selection or qualification.
blockers: No held-out real-room or standards-room paired dereverberation evaluation with pinned RIR provenance, rights and a defined early-reflection target has been run.
No listening/MOS assessment on licensed real speech has been run; synthetic STOI is not a human score.
No target-device CPU, memory, deadline, pacing or content-delay measurement has been run for any causal variant.
No provider intake, rights, license, descriptor and public catalog review has been completed for a realtime v0 provider.
The room profile's delayed/missing render case is not applicable to this mono dereverberation fixture and stays open for any AEC-style qualification.
reopening_conditions: Provide real-room or standards-room RIRs with pinned provenance and a defined early-reflection target, then rerun paired SI-SDR/STOI with identity and noisy controls.
Run listening/MOS with licensed real speech and a declared listener protocol.
Measure the causal variant on the exact target device under the 160-sample grid before any realtime v0 provider proposal.
Complete provider intake, license and descriptor review before changing any installed default, registry or public catalog.
